title: Output multiset cardinality bound in real scale
statement: Let an almost-wise input have independence order $k$ and output dimension $n$, with $1\le k\le n$. Let its bias be the positive rational number whose numerator is $a$ and denominator is $b$, where $2a\le b$, and write $\varepsilon=a/b$. The real-valued cardinality of its output multiset is at most $16(S/\varepsilon)^2$, where $S$ is the size scale.
hypotheses_covered: Independence order is at most the output dimension: $k\le n$
Twice the bias numerator is at most its denominator: $2a\le b$
